hints.title: Depth and Dash Parsing
hints.text: The number of consecutive dash symbols preceding each integer indicates the exact 0-indexed depth of that node within the binary tree.

hints.title: Stack of Ancestors
hints.text: Maintain an evaluation list of active ancestors. When processing a node at depth d, pop items until the list length matches d so that the last element is the parent.

hints.title: Left Child Priority
hints.text: If the parent has no left child, assign the new node as the left child. Otherwise, assign it as the right child. Push the new node onto the list and continue.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively splitting string by depth dashes requires repeated substring searching and high string copy costs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterative parsing with an ancestor buffer builds the tree in a single pass of O(N) time and O(H) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should parse dashes and numbers cleanly and maintain the active path using a buffer.
complexity.notes: Root node is always at index 0 of the ancestor buffer.
